import hashlib,json,os,sys,tarfile
from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath
sys.path.insert(0,'benchmarks/strict-suite')
import measure as m
root=m.ROOT
report=root/'benchmarks/results/2026-10-14-strict-conform-preparation'
prep=root/'build/strict-conform-preparation-attempt1'
roots=[prep,root/'build/conform-dev',root/'build/conform-expanded-chez',root/'build/strict-conform-audit']
paths={p for folder in roots for p in folder.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts}
paths.update(p for p in report.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.json','.md') and p.name not in ('manifest.json','archive-verification.json'))
paths.update(p for p in (root/'benchmarks/strict-suite').iterdir() if p.suffix in ('.py','.mjs'))
paths.add(root/'benchmarks/results/2026-10-14-strict-browse-preparation/inspect-retained-work.py')
runtime=root/'build/native-runtime/release/libsnail_runtime.a'
build,=list((prep/'conform').glob('controls/native/native.native-*/build.json'))
assert m.digest(runtime)==m.load(build)['sha256'][str(runtime)]
paths.add(runtime)
files={str(p.relative_to(root)):p for p in sorted(paths)}
hashes={name:m.digest(path) for name,path in files.items()}
archive=report/'artifacts.tar.xz'
assert not archive.exists()
with tarfile.open(archive,'w:xz',preset=3) as output:
    for name,path in files.items():
        member=tarfile.TarInfo(name)
        member.size,member.mode,member.mtime=path.stat().st_size,path.stat().st_mode & 0o777,0
        with path.open('rb') as source:output.addfile(member,source)
actual={}
with tarfile.open(archive,'r:xz') as source:
    for member in source:
        name=PurePosixPath(member.name)
        assert member.isfile() and not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts and member.name not in actual
        with source.extractfile(member) as contents:
            actual[member.name]=hashlib.file_digest(contents,'sha256').hexdigest()
assert actual==hashes
identity=dict(bytes=archive.stat().st_size,sha256=m.digest(archive))
m.save(report/'manifest.json',dict(archive=identity,files=hashes,roots=[str(p) for p in roots],native_runtime_sha256=m.digest(runtime)))
m.save(report/'archive-verification.json',dict(unique_regular_members=len(actual),complete_member_hash_verification=True,archive=identity))
print(json.dumps(dict(verified_regular_files=len(actual),**identity)),flush=True)
